race.comment: HOOROO (2) is facing the starter for the first time but has shown some ability at the trials and won't need to be a superstar to be competitive against this line-up. Gets Wiggins on board from the low draw and should be right there at the business end. MAJESTIC CHOICE (12) raced below her best last time when eighth over 1200m at Emerald. Facing a tougher assignment but she is up to the task. PROVISEUR (9) finished fourth over 1200m at Rockhampton at his most recent appearance on May 5. Definite top-three chance while fresh. MO SPIRIT (13) will be rock-hard fit for this and is next in line despite the wide gate.
